rule:
负责人 10-18 定）："比对前就说匹配"的**断言式**动作行——HI 动作行的 rationale 含 match / same（词边界），
该步之前没有 compare_media 记录（证据卡片里没有 INSPECT/compare_media、历史里没有 compare_media 调用），且不是 compare_media 那一步
本身、也不是 whether / if / check / verify 一类带保留的问句（口径同 scripts/teaching_matrix.py 的"断言式"）。
带保留措辞的行照常进；不改写教师文本。合包时这些行记 bucket_reason = rationale_premature_match。

rows.rationale: E1 matches E5/E7 (R1) and E8/E10 (R2) showing the same submarine and background, indicating the claim image is a crop of an older South Korean navy photo. I will check R1’s publication date to establish when this image was first published online.

R2 (News18) is a near-identical match found by Yandex and mentions hoardings in Andhra during Modi’s visit; checking its publication and platform upload dates will help determine when and where this image first appeared online, addressing the task’s core requirement.

E10 contains the full text of the News18 article (R2) whose thumbnail matches E1 and is dated 2019-02-10 (E17); reading it will reveal the article's stated location and context for the billboard to compare against the Rajasthan claim.

E1 matches E4 and E6 from R1 (Amar Ujala), confirming the image source; now checking R1's publication date to determine when it first appeared and whether the context supports the 2023 Makar Sankranti claim.

R1 (Sotwe) shows a near-identical image match but lacks date data; R2's page is archived only from 2023-12-08, after the claim date. Checking R3 (dtnext.in) for publication or archive dates may reveal an earlier occurrence of the image to establish first publication.
Image E1 matches E4 from WIRED article R1; I need the publication date of R1 to determine if the image predates the May 2023 claim and verify its original context.

Image E5 from R2 visually matches the original image E1, showing the same leaders in the same setting, indicating R2 may be an early publication of the image. This action will retrieve the publication date of R2 to assess whether it predates the claim date of 2023-01-16 and helps establish the image's original context.

R6 (yemennewstoday.wordpress.com) shows a partial-match thumbnail of the boy in rubble; checking its declared publication date and earliest archive capture will establish whether this source predates the June 2022 Afghanistan earthquake claim and help determine the image's original context.

R6's page date (2016-10-25, E21) predates the 2022 claim, but its thumbnail was only a partial match; R7's article image (E18) also showed a partial match. Checking R7's publication and capture dates will determine if it is an earlier or independent source for Material A.

E16 is the text page for candidate source R6 (Yemen News Today), which returned a partial image match in the reverse search; reading it will reveal the article's date and context to determine if this image was published before the June 2022 earthquake claim.

R5 (NDTV article) appeared in reverse image search with a thumbnail not matching E1; checking its publication date via SEARCH on R5 will establish whether this source predates the 2023-02-08 claim and could represent an earlier context for the image.

Image E1 matches candidate sources R1 (CBS News) and R2 (blogspot) visually; R1 is a credible news archive likely to include publication dates. This SEARCH will retrieve the page's declared publication date and earliest archive capture to establish when the image first appeared online and assess whether it predates the 2023 claim.

The image in E1 matches the Daily Mirror kite festival photo (E7, E4), not the protest claim. To verify the original publication date and context, I will check the dates for R1, the most relevant candidate source.

R1 (info247plus.wordpress.com, 2015-11-14) is the earliest candidate source found with a partial image match to E1; checking its declared publication and archive dates will establish whether this page is the first known online appearance of the image and help assess if the 2022 World Cup claim reuses older material.

E1 shows a Saudi customs officer with a Heineken can inside a Pepsi wrapper, matching the claim's visual. R2 (Imgur) has a partial match and an archive date of 2015-11-13, earlier than R1's 2015-11-14; reading E8 will reveal the Imgur post's text and context to assess original publication and whether it supports the World Cup claim.

The image in E1 matches fact-check articles in R1 and R2 that identify it as a flooded Raymond showroom in Patna, not Mumbai; I now need the publication dates of R1 to establish when this correction first appeared and assess the claim's timeline.

The ABP Live article (R1/R2) dates to 2021-07-25, predating the 2022 claim, but R3 (naidunia.com) is another match mentioning Patna, Bihar; checking its publication date will determine if it is earlier or independent evidence of the image's true origin and context.

The claim links the image to a March 2023 egg boycott in Kisumu County. While R9 (The Star) confirms the boycott announcement, R10 (Kenyans.co.ke) reports on Azimio protesters in Kisumu around the same time; checking its publication date (E16) will help determine if the image's context aligns with the claimed event.

The image E1 matches candidate sources R1 and R2 from India Today dated 2016, predating the 2022 claim. This SEARCH on R1 will obtain its publication date to confirm whether the image's original context (2016 Kerala culling coverage) contradicts the 2022 poisoning claim.

Image E10 shows the same baby photo in an Instagram post by 'abby_abadii12' with '15 HOURS AGO' timestamp, suggesting an earlier publication than the 2022-08-29 claim date. This action will retrieve the actual publication date of R1 to verify if it predates the claim and determine the original context.

Image E10 from R5 (SlideServe) shows the same warehouse scene as E1, suggesting it may be an earlier source; checking R5's publication date will help determine if this predates the 2023 claim and reveals the original context.

The image in E1 matches earlier Trump Ice photos (E4, E8, E13) but the claim ties it to East Palestine (2023). R2’s page text is already read (E6); checking its declared publication and archive dates will show whether this source predates the claim and what context it gives.

The image in E1 matches frames from candidate sources R1-R5, but publication dates are unknown. This SEARCH on R1 with include=[dates] will retrieve the page's declared publication date and earliest archive capture to establish when this image first appeared online.

R5 is the only result reporting a partial match to the #StopAdani image; checking R7's dates (E11) helps rule out unrelated sources while prioritizing verification of R5's publication date and context against the 2023 claim.

E1 visually matches E4 from R1 (The Tribune), indicating the same event; obtaining R1's publication and platform dates will establish when this image first appeared online and help verify whether the 2023 claim aligns with the original context.

R2 (minanews.net) has readable page text E6; checking its declared publication date will help establish when this image first appeared online and confirm its original context.

To locate the exact segment matching the task description, I will use INSPECT with operation locate on video E1 using the text query to find candidate frames where this action occurs.
